lines.caption: Hong Kong to Fukuoka, one week out. First, we protect the seats normal travellers will still buy, leaving 58 seats we can safely open to members.
lines.say: Hong Kong to Fukuoka, one week out. First, we protect the seats normal travellers will still buy — leaving fifty-eight seats we can safely open to members!

lines.caption: Thompson Sampling tests fares on simulated members and learns which price they respond to. HK$229 wins: on fresh test panels, it brings in HK$2,589 more than no offer.
lines.say: Thompson Sampling tests fares on simulated members, and learns which price they respond to. Two twenty-nine wins! On fresh test panels, it brings in about twenty-six hundred dollars more than no offer.

lines.caption: The manager types in the price and publishes the seats.
lines.say: The manager types in the price, and publishes the seats.

lines.caption: On the member site, the deal is clear: HK$690, now HK$229. One click, and the seat is booked!
lines.say: On the member site, the deal is clear: six-ninety, now just two twenty-nine. One click, and the seat is booked!

lines.caption: Back in Admin, the sale shows up instantly: one seat sold, HK$229 in member revenue.
lines.say: Back in Admin, the sale shows up instantly: one seat sold, and two hundred twenty-nine dollars in member revenue.
